## Claims
- [source-backed] The authors report computational verification only for \(r\le4\) and \(n-r\le5\). [source-6, lines 46-54]
- [source-backed] The stronger proposed statement is \(J_v/\Lambda_+J_v\cong\mathbb Z^{\binom{a+b}{a}}\), and the source says a proof eluded the authors. [source-6, lines 56-72]
- [proved] If an exact integral presentation is \(Q\cong\operatorname{coker}(B:\mathbb Z^u\to\mathbb Z^g)\), with Smith form \(\operatorname{diag}(d_1,\ldots,d_s,0,\ldots,0)\), \(d_i>1\), then
  \[
  Q\cong\mathbb Z^{g-s}\oplus\bigoplus_{i=1}^s\mathbb Z/d_i,\qquad
  \mu_{\mathbb Z}(Q)=g-s+\max_p\#\{i:p\mid d_i\}.
  \]
- [unsupported] No exact integral presentation matrix for \(J_v/\Lambda_+J_v\), nor a proof of its exactness, is supplied here; therefore no Smith-normal-form computation is presently justified.

## Strategy
Reformulate the computational task as follows.

1. First provide, for each selected \(v\), an exact certificate
   \[
   \mathbb Z^u\xrightarrow{B_v}\mathbb Z^{g_v}\twoheadrightarrow
   J_v/\Lambda_+J_v\to0,
   \]
   including the chosen generators, all relations, and a proof that the relation lattice is precisely \(\operatorname{im}B_v\).

2. Then run SNF only for nondegenerate instances (\(a,b>0\)) in the bounded beyond-range window
   \[
   (r,n-r)\in\{(5,5),(4,6),(5,6)\}.
   \]
   For every admissible parameter choice in this window, record
   \[
   \operatorname{rank}_{\mathbb Z}Q,\qquad
   (d_i:d_i>1),\qquad
   \mu_{\mathbb Z}(Q).
   \]

3. Label every resulting row as finite computational evidence only; it neither proves the conjecture nor establishes a universal torsion statement.

## Gaps
- The admissible parameter constraints defining the relevant \(v_{r,s,t,n}\) are not supplied.
- The required exact presentation and its proof are absent.
- Thus there is no valid sandbox computation to report.

## Next
Supply the presentation certificate and parameter enumeration; then execute SNF on the stated finite window.
